stories.title: Big wins for the Bills, Browns, Packers and Cardinals? Our reporters make sense of Week 6
stories.summary: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 6.

stories.title: Harbaugh mum on McDaniel, says Chargers need 'to address everything'
stories.summary: Jim Harbaugh said his Chargers will "have to address everything, and especially offensively" after another dismal performance in a 22-6 loss to the Chiefs.

stories.title: Kings guard Simmons has torn Achilles tendon, will undergo surgery
stories.summary: Kings guard Ben Simmons has sustained a torn Achilles tendon and will undergo surgery, the team announced Sunday, an injury that is likely season-ending for the 30-year-old veteran who authored an impressive training camp on short notice for Sacramento.

stories.title: Rays on cusp of World Series after wild weekend
stories.summary: The Rays beat the Guardians 3-1 on Sunday night to take a 3-2 lead in the ALCS.

stories.title: Duke CB apologizes for swatting away trainer's arm as she checked on injured player
stories.summary: Kimari Robinson, the Duke cornerback who swatted the arm of a training staff member as she checked on an injured player during the team's game against North Carolina over the weekend, apologized for his actions Sunday night.
